android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.reason: Broad device app inventory access is heavily restricted and causes immediate rejection unless app is a launcher, security tool, or device search engine.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.remediation: Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES and declare explicit <queries> entries for specific intents/packages only.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Query All Packages Declaration

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.reason: Allows installing external APKs outside Google Play; almost always rejected for media or utility apps.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.remediation: Remove REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES from AndroidManifest.xml and check transitive SDK manifests (tools:node='remove').
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Request Install Packages Declaration

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.reason: Broad shared storage write access is restricted to core file managers, backup tools, and antivirus apps.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.remediation: Remove MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE; use app-specific storage, MediaStore, or Storage Access Framework (SAF).
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> All Files Access Declaration

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.reason: Persistent photo gallery access requires Play Console declaration and justification.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.remediation: Replace with Android Photo Picker for one-time image selection unless your core feature is a gallery/editor.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Photo and Video Permissions

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.reason: Persistent video library access requires Play Console declaration.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.remediation: Remove if unused or migrate to Android Photo Picker.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Photo and Video Permissions

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.reason: Requests access to user's shared audio library. Unnecessary if your app only plays bundled offline assets.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.remediation: Remove READ_MEDIA_AUDIO if all audio tracks are bundled inside app assets/raw resources.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.declaration_required: Ensure justification is clear in store listing if reading user local MP3 files.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.reason: Deprecated on Android 13+; should be removed or scoped with android:maxSdkVersion='32'.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.remediation: Remove if unused, or add android:maxSdkVersion='32'.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.declaration_required: None if removed or properly maxSdkVersion-scoped.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.reason: Deprecated on Android 10+; leaving it unscoped triggers Play Console review warnings.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.reason: Google Play requires a Foreground Service declaration AND a short demo video showing the media playback notification & lock-screen controls.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.remediation: Keep only if background audio playback is a core feature, and complete the Foreground Service declaration with a 15-30s demo video link in Play Console.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_ME.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Foreground Service Permissions (Media Playback + Demo Video)

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.reason: Google discourages dataSync FGS; reviewers often ask to migrate to WorkManager.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.remediation: Migrate background downloads/sync to WorkManager unless long-running user-initiated transfer is required.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Foreground Service Permissions (Data Sync + Demo Video)

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.reason: Special Use FGS undergoes manual review and requires a detailed justification + demo video.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.remediation: Switch to a standard FGS type (e.g., mediaPlayback) or submit full Play Console justification.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SP.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Foreground Service Permissions (Special Use + Video)

com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.reason: App declares Advertising ID permission; Play Console Advertising ID form must match accurately (and must be removed if targeting children).
com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.remediation: Declare 'Yes' in Play Console -> App Content -> Advertising ID (for Advertising/Analytics), OR strip via tools:node='remove' if app has no ads/analytics.
com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Advertising ID Declaration

android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.reason: Restricted on Android 14+ unless app's core function is an alarm clock, timer, or calendar.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.remediation: Use WorkManager or inexact alarms unless exact timing is essential.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.declaration_required: Play Console -> App Content -> Exact Alarm Justification

google_ump.display_name: Google UMP (User Messaging Platform — GDPR/EEA Consent)

official_impersonation_phrases.remediation: Remove 'Official' / 'رسمي' claims unless you hold written publisher authorization; describe the app clearly as an independent/fan audio player.

prohibited_downloader_phrases.policy: Device & Network Abuse / YouTube & Third-Party ToS Violation
prohibited_downloader_phrases.remediation: Remove all third-party video/music downloading claims (YouTube, TikTok, Spotify, SoundCloud). Google Play permanently suspends downloader apps.

third_party_brand_warning_terms.remediation: Avoid referencing unrelated third-party brand names in store metadata to prevent automated IP rejections.
